shots.text: Over Aurvanis we brought down the Thunderhead, a storm gone solid as black glass. It was Aurath's madness. It shattered, and the sky moved again for the first time in a month.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The black solid cloud shattering, frozen lightning falling like glass. Rain. Riders lifting their faces to it.

shots.text: A voice told me to be still. So I was still, and the stone walked in. Never again. My winds are yours.
shots.speaker: aurath
shots.art_note: Aurath, a rider-shape of cloud and lightning, flickering, bowing over the towers.

shots.text: The walking stone fell where it stood. The Galeborn rode home to Aurvanis. Two lands were free.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Boulders crumbling on the plateau. Galeborn raising their tents again at Aurvanis; Kaela watching from her horse.
